questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{设灯泡寿命为}X,\text{依题意有}\\&\quad p=P\{X>1000\}=\frac{1}{2}.\\&\text{又设100只灯泡中有}Y\text{只灯泡的寿命超过1000小时，则}Y\sim B(100,p),\text{即}\\&\quad P\{Y=k\}=C_{100}^{k}p^{k}(1-p)^{100-k}=C_{100}^{k}(\frac{1}{2})^{100},\\&\text{所以100只灯泡中至少有90只灯泡的寿命超过1000小时的概率为}\\&\quad P\{Y\geq 90\}=\sum_{k=90}^{100}P\{Y=k\}=\sum_{k=90}^{100}C_{100}^{k}(\frac{1}{2})^{100}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由于}P\{X=0\}=1-P\{X\geq 1\}=1-\frac{5}{9}=\frac{4}{9}.\\&\text{故由}P\{X=0\}=C_{2}^{0}p^{0}q^{2}=q^{2}=\frac{4}{9},\text{得}q=\frac{2}{3}.\\&\text{从而}P\{Y\geq 1\}=1-P\{\overline{Y}=0\}=1-C_{2}^{0}p^{0}q^{3}=1-q^{3}=1-\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{3}=\frac{19}{27}.\end{aligned}
